mapper.select: SELECT id, version, weights_json, min_confidence, top_n, status, published_at, published_by, created_at, updated_at FROM recommendation_weight WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, version, weights_json, min_confidence, top_n, status, published_at, published_by, created_at, updated_at FROM recommendation_weight WHERE version = #{version} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation_weight (id, version, weights_json, min_confidence, top_n, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{version}, #{weightsJson}, #{minConfidence}, #{topN}, #{status})
